summary: Woolly boy and QiuQiu!, trapped in the Circus, seeks escape
description:
Normally 4.99 USD, it's on sale for 3.49 USD for launch week! Have fun playing!

🎉 From the creator of Rain City, Big Pineapple, and published by Cotton Game, comes the indie adventure puzzle game, Woolly Boy and the Circus! 

🧒 Woolly Boy finds himself trapped in the mysterious Big Pineapple Circus. On his quest for escape, he reunites with his loyal companion, QiuQiu! 🐶

✨ Together, this dynamic duo will work together to unravel the mysteries and escape this fantastical world!🎪

🎮 【Game Features】
🌈 Uncover the Circus Secrets: Meet a colorful cast of characters, hear their stories, and help them overcome their troubles.
🧩 Dynamic Duo Gameplay: Seamlessly switch between Woolly Boy and Ball, utilizing their unique abilities to solve a variety of puzzles.
🧠 Tons of Items and Minigames: Over a hundred items and dozens of meticulously designed minigames will challenge your mind to the limit!
 
📚 【Story】
🎠 You play as Woolly Boy, embarking on an adventure in this whimsical circus. 
🤝 Through interactions with the circus members, you’ll uncover their hidden stories and forge deep friendships. 
⚡ Your journey will require wit and courage to solve intricate puzzles, ultimately helping Woolly Boy and QiuQiu escape the circus.

 【Why Choose Woolly Boy and the Circus?】
🎨 Hand-Drawn Style: Immerse yourself in a charming and fantastical world brought to life with exquisite hand-drawn visuals.
💞 Touching Story: Each character has a unique story waiting to be uncovered.
🔑 Brain-Teasing Puzzles: Challenge your mind and experience the thrill of puzzle-solving.
🐾 Heartwarming and Uplifting: The bond between Woolly Boy and QiuQiu will warm your heart.

☺️ 【Mobile Exclusive Features】☺️
💰 Lower price than the PC version.
🚀 Play before the Steam release!
🎮 One-time purchase, lifetime access.
💎 Enjoy an ad-free premium experience.
🔍 Larger UI and font size for easy reading and gameplay.
👌 Touchscreen optimized interface.
🔋 Reduced battery consumption and heat generation for a smooth, buttery experience on mobile devices.

Join us now and embark on this magical adventure!
